offers_products.reason: Proprietary payment platform and bill-pay software, AP/AR automation, integrated payment technology sold to businesses.

offers_services.reason: Payment processing, bill presentment, and print-and-mail communication services run for lenders, utilities and merchants.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are lenders, utilities, merchants and businesses; consumers only pay bills through the platform.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to lenders, utilities, insurers, government, ISOs and businesses needing AR/AP payment solutions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes mainly from ongoing per-transaction processing fees and platform use by existing clients.

cyclical_demand.reason: Loan repayments, utility and insurance bill payments continue in downturns; volumes are fairly steady.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent per-transaction fees and subscription-style platform use, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for payment technology, integrations and processing networks rather than staff time.

large_customers.reason: Utilities, insurers, government (KUBRA) and consumer lenders are main clients, though small merchants are also served.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and payments platform business; needs technology development, not plants, fleets or properties.

notes: Customer size is mixed: large utilities and lenders alongside smaller merchants.
